items.name: Captures
items.summary: The span offsets of capturing groups after a match has been found.

methods.name: all
methods.summary: Create new storage for the offsets of all matching capturing groups.

methods.name: clear
methods.summary: Clear this `Captures` value.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Create new storage for only tracking which pattern matched. No offsets are stored at all.

methods.name: extract
methods.signature: fn extract<'h, const N: usize>(&self, haystack: &'h str) -> (&'h str, [&'h str; N])
methods.summary: This is a convenience routine for extracting the substrings corresponding to matching capture groups in the given `haystack`. The `haystack` should be the same substring used to find the match spans in this `Captures` value.

methods.name: extract_bytes
methods.signature: fn extract_bytes<'h, const N: usize>(&self, haystack: &'h [u8]) -> (&'h [u8], [&'h [u8]; N])
methods.summary: This is a convenience routine for extracting the substrings corresponding to matching capture groups in the given `haystack`. The `haystack` should be the same substring used to find the match spans in this `Captures` value.

methods.name: get_group
methods.summary: Returns the span of a capturing group match corresponding to the group index given, only if both the overall pattern matched and the capturing group participated in that match.

methods.name: get_group_by_name
methods.summary: Returns the span of a capturing group match corresponding to the group name given, only if both the overall pattern matched and the capturing group participated in that match.

methods.name: get_match
methods.summary: Returns the pattern ID and the span of the match, if one occurred.

methods.name: group_info
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the underlying group info on which these captures are based.

methods.name: group_len
methods.summary: Return the total number of capturing groups for the matching pattern.

methods.name: interpolate_bytes
methods.summary: Interpolates the capture references in `replacement` with the corresponding substrings in `haystack` matched by each reference. The interpolated byte string is returned.

methods.name: interpolate_bytes_into
methods.signature: fn interpolate_bytes_into(&self, haystack: &[u8], replacement: &[u8], dst: &mut Vec<u8>)
methods.summary: Interpolates the capture references in `replacement` with the corresponding substrings in `haystack` matched by each reference. The interpolated byte string is written to `dst`.

methods.name: interpolate_string
methods.summary: Interpolates the capture references in `replacement` with the corresponding substrings in `haystack` matched by each reference. The interpolated string is returned.

methods.name: interpolate_string_into
methods.signature: fn interpolate_string_into(&self, haystack: &str, replacement: &str, dst: &mut String)
methods.summary: Interpolates the capture references in `replacement` with the corresponding substrings in `haystack` matched by each reference. The interpolated string is written to `dst`.

methods.name: is_match
methods.summary: Returns true if and only if this capturing group represents a match.

methods.name: iter
methods.summary: Returns an iterator of possible spans for every capturing group in the matching pattern.

methods.name: matches
methods.summary: Create new storage for only the full match spans of a pattern. This does not include any capturing group offsets.

methods.name: pattern
methods.summary: Returns the identifier of the pattern that matched when this capturing group represents a match. If no match was found, then this always returns `None`.

methods.name: set_pattern
methods.summary: Set the pattern on this `Captures` value.

methods.name: slots
methods.summary: Returns the underlying slots, where each slot stores a single offset.

methods.name: slots_mut
methods.summary: Returns the underlying slots as a mutable slice, where each slot stores a single offset.

items.name: CapturesPatternIter
items.summary: An iterator over all capturing groups in a `Captures` value.

items.name: GroupInfo
items.summary: Represents information about capturing groups in a compiled regex.

methods.name: all_group_len
methods.summary: Return the total number of capture groups across all patterns.

methods.name: all_names
methods.summary: Return an iterator of all capture groups for all patterns supported by this `GroupInfo`. Each item yielded is a triple of the group's pattern ID, index in the pattern and the group's name, if present.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: This creates an empty `GroupInfo`.

methods.name: explicit_slot_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of slots for explicit capturing groups.

methods.name: group_len
methods.summary: Return the number of capture groups in a pattern.

methods.name: implicit_slot_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of slots for implicit capturing groups.

methods.name: memory_usage
methods.summary: Returns the memory usage, in bytes, of this `GroupInfo`.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new<P, G, N>(pattern_groups: P) -> Result<GroupInfo, GroupInfoError> where P: IntoIterator<Item = G>, G: IntoIterator<Item = Option<N>>, N: AsRef<str>
methods.summary: Creates a new group info from a sequence of patterns, where each sequence of patterns yields a sequence of possible group names. The index of each pattern in the sequence corresponds to its `PatternID`, and the index of each group in each…

methods.name: pattern_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of patterns in this `GroupInfo`.

methods.name: pattern_names
methods.summary: Return an iterator of all capture groups and their names (if present) for a particular pattern.

methods.name: slot
methods.signature: fn slot(&self, pid: PatternID, group_index: usize) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the starting slot corresponding to the given capturing group for the given pattern. The ending slot is always one more than the value returned.

methods.name: slot_len
methods.summary: Returns the total number of slots in this `GroupInfo` across all patterns.

methods.name: slots
methods.signature: fn slots(&self, pid: PatternID, group_index: usize) -> Option<(usize, usize)>
methods.summary: Returns the starting and ending slot corresponding to the given capturing group for the given pattern. The ending slot is always one more than the starting slot returned.

methods.name: to_index
methods.signature: fn to_index(&self, pid: PatternID, name: &str) -> Option<usize>
methods.summary: Return the capture group index corresponding to the given name in the given pattern. If no such capture group name exists in the given pattern, then this returns `None`.

methods.name: to_name
methods.signature: fn to_name(&self, pid: PatternID, group_index: usize) -> Option<&str>
methods.summary: Return the capture name for the given index and given pattern. If the corresponding group does not have a name, then this returns `None`.

items.name: GroupInfoAllNames
items.summary: An iterator over capturing groups and their names for a `GroupInfo`.

methods.name: next
methods.signature: fn next(&mut self) -> Option<(PatternID, usize, Option<&'a str>)>

items.name: GroupInfoError
items.summary: An error that may occur when building a `GroupInfo`.

items.name: GroupInfoPatternNames
items.summary: An iterator over capturing groups and their names for a specific pattern.
